name: qing-agent-orchestrator
description: Desktop-first adaptive Direct, Lite, and Full ChatGPT/Codex orchestration with effect gates and optional CLI automation

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/validation.test.js dist/tests/safety-gate.test.js dist/tests/relay.test.js dist/tests/process-runner.test.js dist/tests/codex-exec-executor.test.js dist/tests/config.test.js dist/tests/planner.test.js dist/tests/workspace.test.js dist/tests/git-audit.test.js dist/tests/task-router.test.js dist/tests/routing-precision.test.js dist/tests/execution-mode-router.test.js dist/tests/task-analyzer.test.js dist/tests/model-router.test.js dist/tests/codex-model-catalog.test.js dist/tests/model-health.test.js dist/tests/v0.7-efficiency.test.js dist/tests/model-health-persistent.test.js dist/tests/phase-reclassification.test.js dist/tests/astra-efficiency.test.js
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js doctor --config config/relay.example.json
scripts.demo: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js run examples/game-visual-analyzer/handoff.json --executor mock
scripts.smoke:real: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js execute examples/smoke-test/handoff.json --approve-handoff relay-read-only-smoke-001 --config config/relay.smoke.json --allow-real-execution
